scripts.build: vite build ## Build to static site
scripts.fixtures: uv run tests/fixtures/generate.py ## Generate fixtures for tests
scripts.test:e2e: bun run fixtures && vitest run --config vitest.browser.config.ts ## Run integratgion tests
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e ## Run unit & integration tests
scripts.i18n:compile: lingui compile --typescript ## Compile messages.po file to messages.ts file
scripts.check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json ## Run svelte / typescript checks
